Definition: A small window that opens on top of a program to show a message or ask for input for a short time.
A modal dialog blocks the rest of the program until it is closed. Clicks outside it do nothing.
A container that stacks labels and buttons in rows. Forms and dialogs both use pages.
The strip across the top of a dialog. It shows the dialog's name and a close button.
The control that the keyboard is using right now. A screen reader reads the control that has the focus.
A small piece of text that a website stores in your web browser, formatted to keep data about you. The name is strange, but a cookie is just text.
